## Fixed

- **Broken downloads from the browser.** Some sites make their files inside the page (Telegram Web's videos, music and documents come from its service worker), and links can expire or lead to a login page. NDM used to take such a download over and save what the server sent it instead, often a small web page in place of the video or audio. Now NDM first makes sure the server sends it the same file the browser is getting (the same size, not a web page). If it doesn't, the browser downloads the file itself as usual, so nothing is lost.
- If a server starts sending a web page partway through a download, NDM stops with an error instead of writing the page into the file.
- When NDM can't be reached, the browser now keeps its download instead of dropping it.
- The video panel's **Download** falls back to the browser's own download when NDM can't get the file.

## What's new

- **Tasks → Export extension...** saves NDM's browser extension to a folder you choose, with the steps to load it in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Firefox.
- Message windows grow to fit longer texts.

Update the extension in your browser (its extensions page → reload, or load the exported folder again) to get the browser download fix.
